ex.en: A small car is more economical than a large one.
ex.zh: 小車比大車省錢。

ex.en: This car is very economical on gas.
ex.zh: 這輛車很省油。

ex.en: Buying in bulk is more economical.
ex.zh: 大量購買比較划算。

ex.en: Many economists are ignorant of that fact.
ex.zh: 很多經濟學家都不知道這件事。

ex.en: Economists expect the economy to grow next year.
ex.zh: 經濟學家預期明年經濟會成長。

ex.en: We need to economize on electricity.
ex.zh: 我們需要節省用電。

ex.en: Many families are economizing by cooking at home.
ex.zh: 很多家庭靠在家煮飯來省錢。

ex.en: More and more women have their own careers and are economically independent of their husbands.
ex.zh: 越來越多女性擁有自己的事業，在經濟上不必依賴丈夫。

ex.en: The region has grown economically since the new factory opened.
ex.zh: 新工廠設立後，這個地區在經濟上持續成長。

ex.en: We need to use our resources more economically.
ex.zh: 我們需要更節省地使用資源。

ex.en: You can travel economically if you book early.
ex.zh: 提早訂票的話，旅行可以省很多錢。

ex.en: We heard the echo of our voices from the other side of the valley.
ex.zh: 我們聽見自己的聲音從山谷另一頭傳了回來。

ex.en: There's an echo in this empty room.
ex.zh: 這個空房間裡有回音。

ex.en: Ziri heard the sound of a motorcycle echoing in the valley.
ex.zh: 齊里聽到摩托車的聲音在山谷間迴盪。

ex.en: Her footsteps echoed down the hall.
ex.zh: 她的腳步聲在走廊上迴盪。

ex.en: The manager echoed the CEO's comments.
ex.zh: 經理附和了執行長的說法。

ex.en: Many customers echoed the same complaint.
ex.zh: 許多顧客也提出了同樣的抱怨。

ex.en: Which is more important, economic development or environmental protection?
ex.zh: 發展經濟和保護環境，哪一個比較重要？

ex.en: Algeria is in the midst of an economic crisis.
ex.zh: 阿爾及利亞正處於經濟危機之中。

ex.en: The economic outlook for next year is positive.
ex.zh: 明年的經濟前景看好。

ex.en: The ecological footprint of a country is closely related to its level of economic development.
ex.zh: 一個國家的生態足跡與其經濟發展程度密切相關。

ex.en: The oil spill caused an ecological disaster.
ex.zh: 漏油事件造成了生態浩劫。

ex.en: We must protect the ecological balance of the wetlands.
ex.zh: 我們必須保護濕地的生態平衡。

ex.en: Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
ex.zh: 汙染會對一個地區的生態造成極大的影響。

ex.en: Tourism is damaging the island's ecology.
ex.zh: 觀光正在破壞島上的生態。

ex.en: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
ex.zh: 她是受到他的影響，才開始對生態學感興趣。

ex.en: She is studying marine ecology at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學研讀海洋生態學。

ex.en: Pollution is damaging the ocean's ecosystem.
ex.zh: 污染正在破壞海洋生態系。

ex.en: Bees play an important role in the ecosystem.
ex.zh: 蜜蜂在生態系中扮演重要角色。

ex.en: An eclipse of the moon is a rare phenomenon.
ex.zh: 月食是一種罕見的現象。

ex.en: Did you see the eclipse yesterday?
ex.zh: 你看了昨天的月蝕了嗎？

ex.en: Did you see yesterday's total lunar eclipse?
ex.zh: 你看到昨天的日全食了嗎？

ex.en: Her talent eclipsed that of all the other singers.
ex.zh: 她的才華使所有其他歌手黯然失色。

ex.en: The moon eclipsed the sun for a few minutes.
ex.zh: 月亮遮住了太陽幾分鐘。

eclectic.zh: 不拘一格的、兼收並蓄的

ex.en: She has an eclectic taste in music, from jazz to folk.
ex.zh: 她的音樂品味兼容並蓄，從爵士到民謠都聽。

ex.en: The shop sells an eclectic mix of old and new furniture.
ex.zh: 這家店賣的新舊家具風格混搭、不拘一格。

ex.en: Our eccentric neighbor wears a hat even when he sleeps.
ex.zh: 我們那位古怪的鄰居連睡覺都戴著帽子。

ex.en: People thought she was eccentric, but she was simply creative.
ex.zh: 大家覺得她很古怪，但她其實只是很有創意。

ex.en: My mother is eccentric.
ex.zh: 我媽媽是個怪人。

ex.en: The old man was a harmless eccentric who talked to his plants.
ex.zh: 那位老先生是個無害的怪人，會跟他的植物說話。

ex.en: A stable economy is the aim of every government.
ex.zh: 穩定的經濟是每個政府的目標。

ex.en: He contributed much to the development of the economy.
ex.zh: 他對經濟發展貢獻良多。

ex.en: It will also help to strengthen the city's economy.
ex.zh: 這也有助於強化城市的經濟。

ex.en: We flew economy class to save money.
ex.zh: 為了省錢，我們搭經濟艙。

ex.en: Economy class was full, so we upgraded.
ex.zh: 經濟艙客滿了，所以我們升等了。

ex.en: We always fly economy class to save money.
ex.zh: 為了省錢，我們都搭經濟艙。

ex.en: Economy class seats were all sold out.
ex.zh: 經濟艙的座位全賣完了。
